lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. These centroids form a regular geometric grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Linear vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a series of grid-like anchor nodes along the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient transitioning from high-intensity light on the dorsal edge to deep shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a low-density distribution of approximately 5-7 low-contrast, high-luminance blobs, primarily located in the lower half of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple Echeneidae (remoras) attached to the ventral-posterior region and trailing near the pelvic fins.
